scheme_name_english: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
beneficiary: Eligible street vendors under the current PM SVANidhi rules
benefits: Collateral-free working-capital loans in progressive tranches of up to ₹15,000, ₹25,000 and ₹50,000
Interest subsidy support for eligible timely repayment
Eligible vendors who successfully repay the second tranche may be eligible for a UPI-linked RuPay Credit Card up to ₹30,000 under the restructured scheme
eligibility: Eligible street vendors identified through the applicable survey/certificate process or supported by a Letter of Recommendation from the Urban Local Body/Town Vending Committee, subject to current rules.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending/Identity Card where applicable, or Letter of Recommendation where applicable
Identity and other documents required by the lending/application system
application_process: Apply through the PM SVANidhi system with the Urban Local Body/Town Vending Committee and participating lending institution as applicable.
application_mode: Online / Urban Local Body / Lending Institution
source_type: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
